label: Fair
corporate_parent: Daikin Industries (Japan) — same parent as GSXC18. Acquired Goodman in 2012.

compressor.description: Copeland single-stage scroll compressor. On/off operation only — no modulation. 100% capacity when running.

expansion_device.description: Fixed orifice (piston) — cheapest expansion device. Less efficient than TXV/EEV. More sensitive to refrigerant charge accuracy. Performance degrades significantly with improper charge.

fan_motor.description: PSC (Permanent Split Capacitor) motor — 40-50% efficiency vs 65-75% ECM. Noisier. Higher energy consumption. Builder-grade standard.

cabinet.construction: Light gauge steel. Mesh guard (not louvered). Adequate but not durable long-term.

communicating_system.system: None — basic 24V thermostat compatible. Simplest controls available.

performance_evidence.energy_star: Does NOT meet ENERGY STAR — at code minimum
performance_evidence.builder_grade_reality: This is what goes in $300K-600K tract homes across the US. Code minimum efficiency.

parts_availability.distribution: Widest in industry — any supply house

durability_evidence.expected_lifespan: 8-10 years per repair tech consensus. Simple design = fewer things to break, but lower component quality limits longevity.
durability_evidence.simplicity_advantage: No communicating system, no inverter board, no EEV = fewer failure modes. When it does fail, repairs are cheap and fast.

platform_sharing.amana_identity: Amana ASX14 = same unit. Badge engineering.

professional_consensus.installer_recommendation: Functional but no differentiation. Builder-grade. Every buyer should know this is the floor.
professional_consensus.builder_grade_reality: In $300K-600K tract homes, builders overwhelmingly install this or equivalent ICP brands.
professional_consensus.comparison_to_premium: 14.3 SEER2 vs 24+ SEER2 for premium variable-speed. 74 dB vs 56-58 dB. 8-10yr vs 15-20yr lifespan. The gulf is enormous.
